    overflow: hidden !important;

}

/* 2. Menghilangkan highlight biru/abu-abu saat area luar (overlay) atau menu diklik */
.ast-mobile-popup-drawer-overlay,
.ast-mobile-popup-drawer,
.main-header-menu a, 
.menu-item a,
.ast-mobile-menu-trigger-toggle {
    -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent !important;
    outline: none !important;
    box-shadow: none !important;
}

.main-header-menu a:focus, 
.main-header-menu a:active, 
.menu-item a:focus, 
.menu-item a:active,
.ast-mobile-menu-trigger-toggle:focus,
.ast-mobile-menu-trigger-toggle:active {
    background-color: transparent !important;
    color: inherit !important;
}
/* Cara Sapu Jagat: Hilangkan semua outline/border/shadow saat fokus di area Off-Canvas */
.ast-mobile-popup-drawer *, 
#ast-mobile-popup *,
.ast-mobile-header-wrap * {
    outline: none !important;
    outline-color: transparent !important;
    box-shadow: none !important;
    border-color: transparent !important;
}

/* Tambahan khusus jika browser menggunakan pola focus-visible terbaru */
.ast-mobile-popup-drawer *:focus-visible, 
#ast-mobile-popup *:focus-visible {
    outline: none !important;
    box-shadow: none !important;
}

.ast-mobile-popup-drawer {
    transform: none !important; /* Paksa kontainer utama tidak ikut geser */
    opacity: 0 !important;
    visibility: hidden !important;
    transition: opacity 0.3s ease, visibility 0.3s ease !important;
}

.ast-mobile-popup-drawer.active {
    opacity: 1 !important;
    visibility: visible !important;
}

.ast-mobile-popup-drawer .ast-mobile-popup-inner {
    /* Posisi awal: sembunyi di kanan */
    transform: translateX(100%) !important; 
    transition: transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1) !important;
}

.ast-mobile-popup-drawer.active .ast-mobile-popup-inner {
    transform: translateX(0) !important;
}

.ast-mobile-popup-drawer:not(.active) .ast-mobile-popup-inner {

}

}</style><style id="wp-custom-css">/* 1. Mengunci scroll background saat menu off-canvas aktif */
.ast-off-canvas-active, 
.ast-main-header-nav-open {
    overflow: hidden !important;
    height: 100vh !important;
}

/* 2. Menghilangkan highlight biru/abu-abu saat area luar (overlay) atau menu diklik */
.ast-mobile-popup-drawer-overlay,
.ast-mobile-popup-drawer,
.main-header-menu a, 
.menu-item a,
.ast-mobile-menu-trigger-toggle {
    -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent !important;
    outline: none !important;
    box-shadow: none !important;
}

/* 3. Menghilangkan warna background biru/bekas hover saat menu ditekan (:active / :focus) */
.main-header-menu a:focus, 
.main-header-menu a:active, 
.menu-item a:focus, 
.menu-item a:active,
.ast-mobile-menu-trigger-toggle:focus,
.ast-mobile-menu-trigger-toggle:active {
    background-color: transparent !important;
    color: inherit !important;
}
/* Cara Sapu Jagat: Hilangkan semua outline/border/shadow saat fokus di area Off-Canvas */
.ast-mobile-popup-drawer *, 
#ast-mobile-popup *,
.ast-mobile-header-wrap * {
    outline: none !important;
    outline-color: transparent !important;
    box-shadow: none !important;
    border-color: transparent !important;
}

/* Tambahan khusus jika browser menggunakan pola focus-visible terbaru */
.ast-mobile-popup-drawer *:focus-visible, 
#ast-mobile-popup *:focus-visible {
    outline: none !important;
    box-shadow: none !important;
}
/* --- 1. OVERLAY (Background Hitam) Tetap Diam, Hanya Fade In/Out --- */
.ast-mobile-popup-drawer {
    transform: none !important; /* Paksa kontainer utama tidak ikut geser */
    opacity: 0 !important;
    visibility: hidden !important;
    transition: opacity 0.3s ease, visibility 0.3s ease !important;
}

.ast-mobile-popup-drawer.active {
    opacity: 1 !important;
    visibility: visible !important;
}

/* --- 2. KONTEN/MENU DI DALAMNYA (Baru yang digeser Kiri-Kanan) --- */
.ast-mobile-popup-drawer .ast-mobile-popup-inner {
    /* Posisi awal: sembunyi di kanan */
    transform: translateX(100%) !important; 
    transition: transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1) !important;
}

/* Saat menu aktif/dibuka: geser ke kiri (masuk layar) */
.ast-mobile-popup-drawer.active .ast-mobile-popup-inner {
    transform: translateX(0) !important;
}

/* Saat menu ditutup: paksa elemen di dalamnya langsung ikut geser kanan serempak */
.ast-mobile-popup-drawer:not(.active) .ast-mobile-popup-inner {
    transform: translateX(100%) !important;
}
button, 
.button, 
a {
    -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; /* Menghilangkan warna biru saat ditekan di HP/Mobile */
    outline: none; /* Menghilangkan garis kotak (outline) saat tombol fokus/aktif */
}

button:active, 
button:focus,
.button:active,
.button:focus {

}</style><style id="wp-custom-css">/* 1. Mengunci scroll background saat menu off-canvas aktif */
.ast-off-canvas-active, 
.ast-main-header-nav-open {
    overflow: hidden !important;
    height: 100vh !important;
}

/* 2. Menghilangkan highlight biru/abu-abu saat area luar (overlay) atau menu diklik */
.ast-mobile-popup-drawer-overlay,
.ast-mobile-popup-drawer,
.main-header-menu a, 
.menu-item a,
.ast-mobile-menu-trigger-toggle {
    -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent !important;
    outline: none !important;
    box-shadow: none !important;
}

/* 3. Menghilangkan warna background biru/bekas hover saat menu ditekan (:active / :focus) */
.main-header-menu a:focus, 
.main-header-menu a:active, 
.menu-item a:focus, 
.menu-item a:active,
.ast-mobile-menu-trigger-toggle:focus,
.ast-mobile-menu-trigger-toggle:active {
    background-color: transparent !important;
    color: inherit !important;
}
/* Cara Sapu Jagat: Hilangkan semua outline/border/shadow saat fokus di area Off-Canvas */
.ast-mobile-popup-drawer *, 
#ast-mobile-popup *,
.ast-mobile-header-wrap * {
    outline: none !important;
    outline-color: transparent !important;
    box-shadow: none !important;
    border-color: transparent !important;
}

/* Tambahan khusus jika browser menggunakan pola focus-visible terbaru */
.ast-mobile-popup-drawer *:focus-visible, 
#ast-mobile-popup *:focus-visible {
    outline: none !important;
    box-shadow: none !important;
}
/* --- 1. OVERLAY (Background Hitam) Tetap Diam, Hanya Fade In/Out --- */
.ast-mobile-popup-drawer {
    transform: none !important; /* Paksa kontainer utama tidak ikut geser */
    opacity: 0 !important;
    visibility: hidden !important;
    transition: opacity 0.3s ease, visibility 0.3s ease !important;
}

.ast-mobile-popup-drawer.active {
    opacity: 1 !important;
    visibility: visible !important;
}

/* --- 2. KONTEN/MENU DI DALAMNYA (Baru yang digeser Kiri-Kanan) --- */
.ast-mobile-popup-drawer .ast-mobile-popup-inner {
    /* Posisi awal: sembunyi di kanan */
    transform: translateX(100%) !important; 
    transition: transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1) !important;
}

/* Saat menu aktif/dibuka: geser ke kiri (masuk layar) */
.ast-mobile-popup-drawer.active .ast-mobile-popup-inner {
    transform: translateX(0) !important;
}

/* Saat menu ditutup: paksa elemen di dalamnya langsung ikut geser kanan serempak */
.ast-mobile-popup-drawer:not(.active) .ast-mobile-popup-inner {
    transform: translateX(100%) !important;
}

.ast-off-canvas-active, 
.ast-main-header-nav-open {
    overflow: hidden !important;
    height: 100vh !important;
}

/* 2. Menghilangkan highlight biru/abu-abu saat area luar (overlay) atau menu diklik */
.ast-mobile-popup-drawer-overlay,
.ast-mobile-popup-drawer,
.main-header-menu a, 
.menu-item a,
.ast-mobile-menu-trigger-toggle {
    -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent !important;
    outline: none !important;
    box-shadow: none !important;
}

/* 3. Menghilangkan warna background biru/bekas hover saat menu ditekan (:active / :focus) */
.main-header-menu a:focus, 
.main-header-menu a:active, 
.menu-item a:focus, 
.menu-item a:active,
.ast-mobile-menu-trigger-toggle:focus,
.ast-mobile-menu-trigger-toggle:active {
    background-color: transparent !important;
    color: inherit !important;
}
/* Cara Sapu Jagat: Hilangkan semua outline/border/shadow saat fokus di area Off-Canvas */
.ast-mobile-popup-drawer *, 
#ast-mobile-popup *,
.ast-mobile-header-wrap * {
    outline: none !important;
    outline-color: transparent !important;
    box-shadow: none !important;
    border-color: transparent !important;
}

/* Tambahan khusus jika browser menggunakan pola focus-visible terbaru */
.ast-mobile-popup-drawer *:focus-visible, 
#ast-mobile-popup *:focus-visible {
    outline: none !important;
    box-shadow: none !important;
}
/* --- 1. OVERLAY (Background Hitam) Tetap Diam, Hanya Fade In/Out --- */
.ast-mobile-popup-drawer {
    transform: none !important; /* Paksa kontainer utama tidak ikut geser */
    opacity: 0 !important;
    visibility: hidden !important;
    transition: opacity 0.3s ease, visibility 0.3s ease !important;
}

.ast-mobile-popup-drawer.active {
    opacity: 1 !important;
    visibility: visible !important;
}

/* --- 2. KONTEN/MENU DI DALAMNYA (Baru yang digeser Kiri-Kanan) --- */
.ast-mobile-popup-drawer .ast-mobile-popup-inner {
    /* Posisi awal: sembunyi di kanan */
    transform: translateX(100%) !important; 
    transition: transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1) !important;
}

/* Saat menu aktif/dibuka: geser ke kiri (masuk layar) */
.ast-mobile-popup-drawer.active .ast-mobile-popup-inner {
    transform: translateX(0) !important;
}

/* Saat menu ditutup: paksa elemen di dalamnya langsung ikut geser kanan serempak */
.ast-mobile-popup-drawer:not(.active) .ast-mobile-popup-inner {
    transform: translateX(100%) !important;
}
button, 
.button, 
a {

    outline: none; /* Menghilangkan garis kotak (outline) saat tombol fokus/aktif */
}

button:active, 
button:focus,
.button:active,
.button:focus {
    outline: none;
    box-shadow: none; /* Menghilangkan bayangan biru bawaan browser tertentu */
}</style></head><body itemtype='https://schema.org/Blog' itemscope='itemscope' class="wp-singular post-template post-template-elementor_header_footer single single-post postid-3108 single-format-standard wp-custom-logo wp-embed-responsive wp-theme-astra ast-desktop ast-page-builder-template ast-no-sidebar astra-4.13.5 group-blog ast-blog-single-style-1 ast-single-post ast-inherit-site-logo-transparent ast-hfb-header ast-full-width-primary-header ast-full-width-layout ast-sticky-main-shrink ast-sticky-header-shrink ast-inherit-site-logo-sticky ast-primary-sticky-enabled ast-normal-title-enabled loftloader-lite-enabled elementor-default elementor-template-full-width elementor-kit-4 elementor-page elementor-page-3108 astra-addon-4.12.4"><div id="loftloader-wrapper" class="pl-imgloading" data-show-close-time="15000" data-max-load-time="15000"><div class="loader-section section-fade"></div><div class="loader-inner"><div id="loader"><div class="imgloading-container"><span style="background-image: url(https://iympack.id/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/logotp-removebg-preview.png);"></span></div><img width="70" height="69" data-no-lazy="1" class="skip-lazy" alt="loader image" src="https://iympack.id/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/logotp-removebg-preview.png"></div></div><div class="loader-close-button" style="display: none;"><span class="screen-reader-text">Close</span></div></div> <script type="litespeed/javascript">(function(){if(window.matchMedia('(max-width:921.99px)').matches){document.body.classList.add('ast-header-break-point');document.body.classList.remove('ast-desktop')}})()</script> <a

.ast-off-canvas-active, 
.ast-main-header-nav-open {
    overflow: hidden !important;
    height: 100vh !important;
}

/* 2. Menghilangkan highlight biru/abu-abu saat area luar (overlay) atau menu diklik */
.ast-mobile-popup-drawer-overlay,
.ast-mobile-popup-drawer,
.main-header-menu a, 
.menu-item a,
.ast-mobile-menu-trigger-toggle {
    -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent !important;
    outline: none !important;
    box-shadow: none !important;
}

/* 3. Menghilangkan warna background biru/bekas hover saat menu ditekan (:active / :focus) */
.main-header-menu a:focus, 
.main-header-menu a:active, 
.menu-item a:focus, 
.menu-item a:active,
.ast-mobile-menu-trigger-toggle:focus,
.ast-mobile-menu-trigger-toggle:active {
    background-color: transparent !important;
    color: inherit !important;
}
/* Cara Sapu Jagat: Hilangkan semua outline/border/shadow saat fokus di area Off-Canvas */
.ast-mobile-popup-drawer *, 
#ast-mobile-popup *,
.ast-mobile-header-wrap * {
    outline: none !important;
    outline-color: transparent !important;
    box-shadow: none !important;
    border-color: transparent !important;
}

/* Tambahan khusus jika browser menggunakan pola focus-visible terbaru */
.ast-mobile-popup-drawer *:focus-visible, 
#ast-mobile-popup *:focus-visible {
    outline: none !important;
    box-shadow: none !important;
}
/* --- 1. OVERLAY (Background Hitam) Tetap Diam, Hanya Fade In/Out --- */
.ast-mobile-popup-drawer {
    transform: none !important; /* Paksa kontainer utama tidak ikut geser */
    opacity: 0 !important;
    visibility: hidden !important;
    transition: opacity 0.3s ease, visibility 0.3s ease !important;
}

.ast-mobile-popup-drawer.active {
    opacity: 1 !important;
    visibility: visible !important;
}

/* --- 2. KONTEN/MENU DI DALAMNYA (Baru yang digeser Kiri-Kanan) --- */
.ast-mobile-popup-drawer .ast-mobile-popup-inner {
    /* Posisi awal: sembunyi di kanan */
    transform: translateX(100%) !important; 
    transition: transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1) !important;
}

/* Saat menu aktif/dibuka: geser ke kiri (masuk layar) */
.ast-mobile-popup-drawer.active .ast-mobile-popup-inner {
    transform: translateX(0) !important;
}

.ast-mobile-popup-drawer:not(.active) .ast-mobile-popup-inner {
    transform: translateX(100%) !important;
}
